name: Safina
description: A star 83 parsecs away, 28 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114341: radius 27.898 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 290.845 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.058) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114341: effective temperature 4516 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.068)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 2.15 from 2007A&A...475.1003H; the 5 published values span log g 2.02 to 2.34, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114341: distance 82.988 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.018), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 83 parsecs away, 28 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 291 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,516 K, so 27.898 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 114341: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: 88 Aquarii
quotes.card: 88 Aquarii is the Flamsteed designation, though it also bears the Bayer designation c2 Aquarii.
quotes.introduction: In dark conditions it is visible to the naked eye with an apparent visual magnitude of +3.68.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2386316510063903616 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none
